baii_issue: Catalogue-scale TESS flare/QPP populations already exist at multiple cadences and scales.
design_resolution: Freeze BAIIW0001 (20-s TESS Sectors 27-80) as the sole parent catalogue; primary strata are all source QPP-selected references plus a deterministic 1:1 matched sample from source non-selected flares.
scientific_rationale: Keeps F3A a robustness stress test of an independently defined source population rather than a new catalogue-construction exercise.
remaining_limitation: Event-level source table/schema and archive mapping must be physically verified in F3A.2; failure blocks materialization.

baii_issue: Different published TESS catalogue-construction pipelines produce materially different flare universes.
design_resolution: Use one external frozen source catalogue (BAIIW0001); do not rebuild flare detection or switch catalogues based on F3A outcomes. BAIIW0003 is secondary reference context and BAIIW0023/0145 are positioning-only.
scientific_rationale: Separates upstream catalogue construction from the QPP-classification robustness question and avoids post hoc source selection.
remaining_limitation: The event-level catalogue artifact must be located/checksummed in F3A.2.

baii_issue: Automated flare-detection and vetting pipelines encode target/event-selection choices before QPP analysis.
design_resolution: Freeze deterministic source identity, duplicate/repeated-sector handling, all-source QPP inclusion, and 1:1 matched non-selected sampling before light-curve execution.
scientific_rationale: Prevents QPP outcome, admissibility, or later AFINO results from selecting/replacing events.
remaining_limitation: Exact source field names are deferred mechanically to F3A.2, not scientifically.

baii_issue: Included literature uses both AFINO and neural-network QPP classifications, while observational labels are not physical truth.
design_resolution: Primary observational labels come from BAIIW0001 and remain non-ground-truth. External labels are separate annotations; conflicts are flagged and never resolved from F3A output.
scientific_rationale: Directly resolves BAII's classifier/provenance concern without turning observational non-selection into truth.
remaining_limitation: Cross-match availability for BAIIW0003 is optional secondary context and cannot alter primary membership.

baii_issue: QPP conclusions can depend on explicit window/detrending choices, and wavelet analysis provides a concrete alternative window-sensitive procedure.
design_resolution: Deliberately reuse all 13 frozen F2 temporal perturbations exactly, declared prospectively, with seed 0 and no data-driven addition/removal.
scientific_rationale: Tests scale generalization of the F2 robustness phenomenon with a prespecified complete window family.
remaining_limitation: Source window markers must map deterministically to native cadences in F3A.2.

baii_issue: Alternative baseline, detrending and stochastic-process models can change flare/event representations.
design_resolution: Deliberately reuse the six F2 processing profiles exactly; no new BAII comparator enters the 78-cell primary matrix.
scientific_rationale: Preserves a confirmatory connection to F2 while avoiding post-result profile tuning and scope expansion.
remaining_limitation: Alternative processing methods remain documented comparator/positioning context.

baii_issue: Quality filtering, gap filling and input admissibility can be explicit parts of automated flare pipelines.
design_resolution: Freeze the F2 admissibility principles: no interpolation/gap filling/silent reindexing; explicit QUALITY policies; inadmissible, incomplete numerical and baseline mismatch states remain separate from non-selection.
scientific_rationale: Keeps denominators auditable and prevents missing/failed inputs from becoming observational negatives.
remaining_limitation: Exact product availability is resolved during F3A.2 without changing the scientific rule.

baii_issue: AFINO is an automated model-comparison implementation, but the software record does not establish optimizer uniqueness or seed stability.
design_resolution: Primary matrix uses seed 0; numerical stability is separately frozen to W00/P00 with external seeds 0-9 for every eligible cohort event and explicit BIC/period/payload/warning/bounds/convergence diagnostics.
scientific_rationale: Scales numerical auditing without multiplying the 78-cell scientific matrix and preserves the distinction between stable classification and optimizer uniqueness.
remaining_limitation: Convergence remains whatever the execution can audit; absence of unique-optimum evidence is not repaired post hoc.

baii_issue: BAII.4 identified 11 sufficiently defined methodological comparator candidates.
design_resolution: Resolve all 11 BAII candidates prospectively: none enters the primary 78-cell matrix; direct/upstream methods are either citation/positioning or deferred to F3B according to whether they require training, known truth, injection-recovery or a new scientific model family.
scientific_rationale: Avoids automatic adoption while documenting every BAII comparator and preventing unplanned method additions after results.
remaining_limitation: No secondary implementation is authorized in design v1; any future implementation requires a versioned amendment before its results are inspected.

baii_issue: Catalogue-scale TESS QPP analysis and TESS catalogue QPP classification already appear in the included literature.
design_resolution: Freeze the bounded contribution: catalogue-scale robustness of independently defined observational QPP classifications under prospectively specified perturbations; prohibit priority, validation, correction and first-study wording.
scientific_rationale: Distinguishes F3A from existing TESS/QPP catalogues by its robustness question rather than by priority.
